narrative: A folded sheet on the chest, wax on it, a hand still near the seal. The window is open on the close. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sealed the sheet and wrote the direction.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Named on the outside. Not present.

entities.name: Thomas Hobbins
entities.context: Named as the carrier. Not in the house.
